key_concepts: Matter can change physical form when heated or cooled
Physical change alters one or more physical properties of matter
Melting, freezing, condensation, evaporation, deposition, and sublimation are processes th
Evaporation is the change from liquid to gas
Heat from the sun causes water in wet clothes to evaporate
Wet surfaces such as floors and roads dry through evaporation
Condensation is the change from gas to liquid
Cooling causes water vapor to become liquid droplets
Droplets on a cold glass are an example of condensation
Water vapor on cold windows is an example of condensation
Dew on leaves is an example of condensation
